open_points.subject: public_op:delivery_store.store_image
open_points.text: a link in the store cannot be resolved
open_points.question: Does this include the destination file itself when it is a dangling or looping symbolic link, or only folder links on the path to the destination?
options: Treat an unresolvable link at any component, including the destination file, as UNSAFE_REFERENCE.
Check only folder links; atomically replace a destination-file link as the stored image.
Check every unresolvable link anywhere in the binary store, even when it is unrelated to this reference.
open_points.default_guess: Check every component of the destination path, including the destination file, but do not inspect unrelated store paths.

witness.initial: The binary store and destination folders are inside the store, but photos/<project_id>/<source_id>.jpg already exists as a dangling symbolic link.
events: module:photo_delivery calls delivery_store.store_image for that project and source.
One implementation resolves the final component and finds the dangling link; another checks only the containing folders before performing the atomic replacement.
outcomes: The operation raises DelivererError with RefusalCode.UNSAFE_REFERENCE and leaves the link unchanged.
The operation replaces the link with the JPEG and returns photos/<project_id>/<source_id>.jpg.
witness.observer: The calling flow sees refusal versus success, and the owner sees a link versus a stored image.

open_points.subject: public_op:delivery_store.store_image
open_points.question: Before returning UNSAFE_REFERENCE, must store_image leave the binary store completely unchanged, or may it create or leave temporary files or directories so long as the final image is not written?
options: Perform all safety checks before creating any filesystem object and leave the store byte-for-byte unchanged.
Permit creation followed by cleanup of temporary files or directories before raising.
Permit a temporary file or newly created directory to remain when cleanup fails, because only the final image is forbidden.
open_points.default_guess: Perform the containment and link-resolution checks before creating any directory or temporary file, and leave the store unchanged on UNSAFE_REFERENCE.

witness.initial: The destination path contains an unresolvable link, and no final stored image exists.
events: One implementation validates the reference before starting its atomic-write machinery.
Another implementation creates an atomic-write temporary file before completing link resolution, then raises UNSAFE_REFERENCE; cleanup of that temporary file fails.
outcomes: UNSAFE_REFERENCE is returned and the binary store is unchanged.
UNSAFE_REFERENCE is returned and a temporary file remains, although the final image was not written.
witness.observer: The owner or a later store operation inspecting the binary store sees the leftover temporary file.
